tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs dang 'brel ba'i srung ba zab mo'i byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pra tī t+ya sa mut+pā da hri da ya bi dhi dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal to// de skad gsungs pa dge sbyong che// tshig 'di sgrub pa'i cho ga ni// sems can rnams la phan byed pa// las kun grub par byed pa'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu gsungs// rigs kyi bu dag gang gis ni// dang por bcom ldan sangs rgyas la// gus shing dad pa'i sems bskyed nas// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// rten 'brel zab mo'i cho ga bshad// thams cad las dang mthun par gsungs// dang por 'jug pa'i chos gsungs pa// 'di ltar las dang nyon mongs yod gyur na// sems can rnams ni 'khor bar 'gro 'gyur la// las dang nyon mongs med na 'khor ba las kyang ldog /bden pa 'di yis bdag gi bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can rnams kyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di lta ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data

te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ las rnams kun gyi cho ga la// tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag brjod// bsam rgyud rang gi lag mthil la// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku// skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyis brgyan// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras// me yi khams la bzhugs par bsgom// de ni lha dag rjes su dran// de ni sbyor ba'i las bshad de// rim pa bzhin du so sor bstan// rims kyis btab nas na ba dang*// klad pa na dang mig nad dang*// khong nad la sogs nad rnams la// tshigs bcad 'di dang snying po 'di// mang por bzlas shing langs nas ni// lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis// dbyung ba'i thabs su byabs par bya'o// nad rnams thams cad sos par 'gyur// nyin gcig nyin gnyis nyin gsum dang*// nyin bzhi rtag pa'i rims rnams la// bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba yi// skud pa dkar po sum bsgril la// bzlas brjod nyi shu brgyad bzlas nas// mgul tu btags na bde bar 'tsho// nad la phan pa'i sman rnams la// gzungs sngags 'di dag bzlas shing btag /snying nad rtsib logs na ba dang*// khong na nad rnams ci yod la// chu la sngags 'di mang bzlas nas// blud na phan zhing bde bar 'gyur// nad la phan pa'i sman rnams la// bzlas shing btang na 'tsho bar 'gyur// g.yen pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*// phol mig dang ni rma reng la// grog tshang sa la snying po 'di// mang du bzlas shing btab na 'tsho// gzhang 'brum gzhang nad sa gu dang*// pho mtshan skrang zhing na ba la// skyes pa'i khaṇ+ḍa'i ril bu'am// byang chub sems dpa'i ril bu la// nyi shu bzlas shing bskus na phan// nad kyi rnam pa gang na yang*// nad tshabs che chung tshod brtags nas// tshigs su bcad pa'i bzlas brjod la// mang nyung nad dang sbyar nas su// lus la byab cing bzlas na phan// 'khru bag nad kyis btab pa la// sman nam ril bu kha zas la// bdun nam nyi shu bzlas nas su// khong du btang na phan par 'gyur// de yi bzlas brjod snga ma ste// 'di dag rab tu bzlas par bya/

na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e paṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ de dag bzlas na nad rnams 'tsho// de ni nad rnams 'tsho ba'o// de nas yang ni bka' stsal pa// nas dang gro dang sran ma dang*// 'bras dang sran chung mon sran dang*// shing tog rgun 'brum a ru ra// de dag kun la za ba yi// srin bu sbur bu phye ma leb// bye'u dang byi ba ne tso dang*// lo tog za ba kha bcing na// zhing gi khyon dang sbyar nas kyang*// bye ma sa dang thal ba la// bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas// zhing dang shing tog gtor byas na// de dag kun kyang kha bcing 'gyur// ha cang char pa ches pa na// bcom ldan 'das la phul ba yi// me tog dman ma re re la// bzlas brjod nyi shu rtsa gcig bya// gtsang zhing bde ba'i gnas dag tu// dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus dag tu// bum pa gang ba'i steng dag tu// kham phor gtsang ma'i nang du yang*// me tog gtsang ma bzlas pa de// bsregs na char pa chad par 'gyur// ser ba drag po 'ong ba na// se ba nya mig lcug ma la// bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas// ser ba gang nas g.yo ngos su// klad la bskor zhing byabs na chad// yang na thal chen yungs kar la// bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bya// thum po byas te lcug ma la// btags te btsugs na ser ba chad// 'byung po sha za yi dwags dang*// rjed byed gdon gyis zin pa la// dkyil 'khor 'dom gang gru bzhi la// bum pa gtsang ma lnga bzhag ste// gu gul dud pas bdug nas kyang*// yungs kar ga pur tsan+dan dang*// gla rtsi la sogs sman sbyar te// bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas// gos dang zas ni dkar por sbyar// dkyil 'khor de yi nang du gzhug /bum pa'i chu yis bkru bar bya// sangs rgyas sku bsil byas pa'i chus// bkru zhing blud na rab tu phan// nad dang gnod pa kun las thar// 'byung po rjed byed sha za yis// glags kyang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// byis pa gdon gyis 'jigs pa la// gi wang la ni sngags bzlas nas// snying po stobs chen 'di bris gdags/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha na da ha/ pa tsa bidh+wan+sa ya/ dzā ṭi laṃ bo dha ra/ u ts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gtsang sbra byas te mgul par gdags// de bzhin yungs kar dag la yang*// bzlas brjod byas te gtum la gdags// mkha' 'gro'i gdon gyis zin pa na// yungs kar dang ni gu gul la// sngags gnyis lan ni bdun bdun bzlas// dud pas bdugs na 'tsho bar 'gyur// de la the tshom mi za'o// byis pa gdon dang nad las thar// bud med bu ni thogs gyur na// chu la bzlas brjod lnga bdun byas// blud na legs par btsa' bar 'gyur// bud med mo gsham bu med la// sangs rgyas sku bsil byas pa'i chu// de la sngags brjod nyi shu bya// khrus byas lus ni gtsang ma la// chu de blud na bu tsha 'phen// rigs brgyud dag ni 'phel bar 'gyur// lam du zhugs te 'gro ba na// skud pa dang ni gos kyi grwar// bzlas brjod bdun bzlas mdud pa bdun// mdud bcings bzlas te song ba na// bde bar 'gro zhing don yang 'grub// dgra dang nye zho med par 'gyur// yid ni gzhungs par 'dod pa na// shu dag tshon gang tsam pa dang*// mar srang sum brgya drug cu la// bzlas brjod byas te bsres nas kyang*// bum pa gcig tu blugs la dkrugs// nyi ma re re lo gcig tu// shu dag dag ni dum re dang*// mar srang dag ni re re la// bzlas brjod re re bya zhing bza'// des ni yid gzhungs blo ldan 'gyur// de bzhin ba ni ser skya ma'i// mar dang 'o ma dag la yang*// bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad du// bzlas te 'o thug dkrug cing bza'// yid gzhungs pa yi mchog tu 'gyur// mi dang 'grogs shing mdza' 'dod na// gang dag yid dang 'thad pa yi// me tog dang ni rtswa shing gi /'bras bu'am ni 'ji ba dag /lag pa g.yas pa'i changs par bcug /bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa gcig gdab// gang gi lag tu byin pa na// de dang rtag tu mdza' bar 'gyur// rta la sogs pa'i phyugs rnams kun// 'chi bar nye bar gnas pa na// chu dang yungs kar bcas pa la// bzlas brjod brgya ni rtsa brgyad bya// de la gtor na sos par 'gyur// yang na yungs kar brgya brgyad la// bzlas pa'i thum po mgul du gdags// de ni nad med bde bar 'gyur// mi rnams 'chi bas 'jigs gyur na// yungs kar la ni bzlas brjod bya// thum po byas te sgo la gdags// bzlas brjod brgya stong 'bum yang bzlas// mi nad dang ni phyugs nad kun// ming yang med cing bde bar 'gyur// de dag kun gyi bzlas brjod ni// 'di dag kun du rgya cher gsungs// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/

oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni rodha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na ni// bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur// gnod pa cis kyang tshugs mi 'gyur// dam chos yongs su gzung bar 'gyur// tshigs su bcad pa'i 'di dag gi /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// cho ga 'di dag thams cad ni// gang la dad pas yid ches na// 'grub par the tshom med par 'gyur// bzlas brjod 'bum ni byas gyur na// dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// ston pa shākya'i thugs rje 'di// dge slong ner ban rak+ṣi tas// tho gar yul nas rnyed pa ste// 'gro ba kun gyi dpal du shar// 'phags pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i cho ga'i gzungs rdzogs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ rten 'brel gyi srung ba byed par 'dod pas/ shākya thub pa lugs ma'am/ ras bris kyi drung du mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma bsham/ bsrung ba'i yul du yod pas khrus legs par byas la/ gral la bsdad de maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob dpon gyis dmigs pa rnams ston te/ thog mar ras bris sam/ lugs sku de nyid shākya thub pa mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa spro bsdus/ sems can gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis skor bar bsams la/ skur gyur pa ni thams cad ces bya bas phyag gsum bya/ de nas ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa slob dpon gyi rjes su bzlas pa 'di skad bya'o// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/

'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur pa/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad khong du chud pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ dgra dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyi rlabs kyis/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol la gdab la/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi rjes zlos byas par bsam ste/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni rodha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum rang gis gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig gis gsol ba btab la/ de'i rjes su bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi rten 'brel gyi snying po lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ de nas rten 'brel gyi rdzas bong nga nag po/ shu dag gu gul nag po gsum la rten 'brel gyi snying po nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ me la bsregs la/ rlung rtsol ba nas lan gsum bus la/ nad kyi rgyu dang*/ nad kyi rkyen dang*/ rnam rtog thams cad sangs bus la/ bus pa'i tha ma la/ rlung nang du 'ong du mi gzhug par thub tshod gcig phyir bzhag nang du rngub pa dang g.yas bkag la srog nas rngubs pas/ yid kyis rten 'brel gyi snying po'i yi ge dang*/ rten 'brel gyi dud pa des lus thams cad khrig gis khengs par bsams la mchil ma mid la rlung nang du thub tshad cig mnan/ de nas slob dpon gyi phyag tu me tog gcig phul la/ slob dpon gyi me tog dang bcas pa'i lag pas bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir spyi bo'am/ dpral bar reg la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i byin gyis rlabs kyis che ge mo'i nad thams cad las bsrung du gsol/
ces slob dpon gyis kyang gsol ba gdab la/ de nas theb kyu re dang chang bu re la chu blugs la/ sarba bighān gyi sngags gsum gyis nad bdag mo la byin la/

nad kyi bdag mo 'khor bcas rnams la sbyin no// bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa byang chub sems dang ldan par gyur cig g.yas phyogs nas bskor bas rgyang ring du 'phang*/ lan gsum btang*/ khro bo'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ slar log tu mi gzhug de nas mchod pa'i gral na yod pa'i gtor ma de byin rlabs gang yang rung bar byas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma khyad par can rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod do// la sa gtsang sar gtong ngo*// dga' ston ji ltar 'byor pa bya'o// rten 'brel la mnga' brnyes pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i gdams ngag rje sa skya pa la babs pa'o// shin tu zab po*/ 'di la rmi lam ngan pa zhi ba dang*/ nad byung ba zhi ba dang*/ dgra zhi bar bya ba'ang snang ngo*// rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos mdzad pa'o// ༈ /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ rten 'brel snying po'i them yig la// 'thug gsum log gsum shad ni gcig /ring po brgyad du shes par bya// dha 'thug gnyis dang bha 'thug cig /sha log gnyis dang na log gcig /shā log gnyis dang wa gnyis dang*// rmā dang thā dī hā rnams ring*// datra dang te yi bar na shad// gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags gsum// dbu na oṃ dang mthar swā hā/ gsang sngags kyi ni rten 'brel te// oṃ dang swa hā mi ldan na// spyan 'byed kyi ni sngags min gsungs// dbu na na mo rat+na tra yā ya// mjug tu swā hā gzungs sngags lugs// dbu na ye dhar mjug tu ṇaḥ /rig sngags lugs zhes chos rjes gsungs// bod skad bsgyur na 'di skad du// chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig yin gsung*/

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung sgros 'phags pas mdzad// ༈ /rten 'brel srung ba'i byin rlabs bya tshul man ngag dang bcas pa phan bde'i char sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa s+t+wi sid+dhaṃ/ stong dang rten 'brel dbyer med snying po'i don// mngon gyur shākya'i gtso la gus btud nas// gzungs sngags zab mo'i byin rlabs man ngag bcas// phan bde'i char 'bebs 'dod dgu'i sprin chen spro// 'di la gsum/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyun gyi nyams len/ las sgrub pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ sbyor ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po ni/ gnas gtsang zhing dben par thub pa'i dbang po'i sku ring bsrel gyi snying po can nam/ ras bris zhal shar du phyogs te bkram pa'i spyan sngar me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ phyogs skyong la 'bul rgyu'i gtor ma dkar zlum/ nye logs ci bde bar sbyong chas/ rten 'brel gyi rdzas sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du bya/ de nas slob dpon rang nyid khyim pa yin na gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang*/ gang ltar yang khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rten 'brel zab mo'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi mdun du seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku mdog gser gyi lhun po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu mtshan dpes spras shing*/ phyag g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam bzhag zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing 'gro ba kun la bu ltar gzigs pa'i thugs rje can sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/

thal sbyar dang bcas gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ skur gyur pa ni thams cad la// mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' zhing*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das phyag 'tshal// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chags pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la yang phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag bya/ mchod pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rnams dngas shing thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon phul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā la ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya rnams sbyar te mchod pa lngas mchod/ thal mo sbyar nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ chos thams cad khong du chud pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i byin rlabs kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi rjes zlos byed par bsam ste/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis sngags kyi sgo nas rang gis gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig gis gsol ba btab/ de'i rjes la bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung gi rten 'brel snying po lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byas par bsams la/ rten 'brel snying po ci nus mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ slob ma rnams phyi rol tu khrus byas/ nang du rang rang gi gral la 'khod nas me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal gdab pa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad kyang bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'du ba las 'dir theg pa chen po yin/ theg chen la'ang rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis las 'dir 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la'ang rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa las 'dir bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang nang gses su mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud gnyis las 'dir mdo sde rtog pa'i rgyud kyi nang tshan/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i gzungs dang*/ cho ga zhib mo'i rjes 'brangs te rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba/ mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal bir+wa pas legs par bkral zhing*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa'i rten 'brel snying po'i srung ba'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga zab mo sgrub pa la/

thog mar gzungs kyi gleng gzhi dang gzhung gi don cung zad gsol na/ sngon gyi tshe bdag cag gi ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i dga' tshal du spyod lam zhi ba rnams kyi mchog rta thul la sogs pa'i nyan thos chen po rnams dang*/ 'phags pa byams pa dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i khyu mchog rnams dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ srid med kyi bu la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba rnams dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la thugs brtse bas dgongs te bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med par 'phel ba'i phyir byin rlabs dang phan yon mtha' yas pa'i gzungs 'di nyid zhus pa na/ ston pas kyang dgyes bzhin du mchod rten bya ba'i cho ga dang bcas bka' stsal to// de yang legs sbyar lha'i skad du ye dharmā la sogs pa'i gzungs kyi sngags tshig 'di rnams bod skad du/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// de la 'gogs pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// zhes 'byung ba 'dis sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mtha' dag gi don gyi sdom chen po 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi ston pa yin te/ de yang nyan thos kyi theg pa ltar na/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni khams gsum gyi nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ji snyed pa'o// kun 'byung gi bden pa ni gang zag gi bdag tu lta bas rab tu phye ba'i las dang nyon mongs pa ste sdug bsngal gang las skye ba'i nyer len du gyur pa'o// 'gog pa'i bden pa ni ji skad bshad pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas pa las rnam par grol ba'i lhag bcas dang lhag med kyi mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang ngo*// lam gyi bden pa ni kun 'byung gi bden pa spong ba'i rgyu gang zag gi bdag med 'khor dang bcas pa'o// theg chen pha rol tu phyin pa ltar na/

gtso bor sdug bsngal gyi bden pa nyan rang dgra bcom dang*/ theg chen slob pa'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal gyi bden pa phra mor gyur pa dag dang*/ kun 'byung gi bden pa de dag gi nyer len chos la dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi shes bya'i sgrib pa phra ba dang*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa mtha' gnyis las rab tu brgal ba'i myang 'das dang*/ lam gyi bden pa bdag med gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa'o// rdo rje theg pa ltar na/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i skabs su bden pa gzhan rnams phal cher theg chen thun mong ma yin pa dang tshul mthun zhing*/ lam bden la thabs kyi rim pa zab mos phye bas rim bzhin du khyad par 'phags pas na 'bras bu la myur du sbyor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med par/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa tha mal gyi snang zhen dang*/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rtog pa/ kun 'byung gi bden pa 'pho ba'i bag chags/ lam gyi bden pa smin grol zab mo'i thabs las skyes pa'i ye shes/ 'gog pa'i bden pa kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang ste/ de ltar na tshigs su bcad pa 'di kho nas mdo rgyud thams cad kyi brjod bya mtha' dag dngos bstan dang*/ sbas don gyi tshul gyis gsal bar mtshon pa'i phyir ji skad du/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku yin te/ sus rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mthong pa des de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ngo*// zhes gsungs la/ gzhan yang nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i bden pa bzhi dang*/ rang rgyal dang thun mong ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis dang*/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i stong pa nyid dang*/ rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo dbyer mi phyed pa'i bden gnyis zung 'jug gi mtshon tshul sogs mtha' yas par 'chad du yod do// de ltar na de lta bu'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kun gyi snying por gyur pa la dad pa dang nges shes mchog tu bskyed nas thog mar byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/

de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas slob dpon gyis dmigs pa rnams gsal gdab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du sku gzugs 'di dang tha mi dad pa'i seng ges zhes pa nas mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur par gong bzhin/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams dang sems can thams cad lus zhing rdul dang mnyam pas phyag byas par mos la thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gdangs yod med gang rung gis/ skur gyur pa sogs gong bzhin/ bdag gzhan gyi lus longs spyod mchod pa lnga po 'di sogs su sprul nas phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ dpon slob lhan cig pas bsang sbyang nas 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ de nas bdag la rten 'brel zab mos nad gdon bar chad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das sogs gong bzhin/ slar yang sngags kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ye dharmā nas swā hā'i bar tshar gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bdag cag gi ston pa sogs sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis rten 'brel zab mo'i don ston pa'i sngags gsungs pa'i rjes zlos byas par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gzungs tshar gsum/ rten 'brel gyi rdzas shu dag dkar po/ bong nga nag po/ gu gul nag po rnams sbyar ba'i phye ma la slob dpon gyis byin gyis brlab pa ni rten snying nyer gcig bzlas la mchil ma ma 'thor bar phu btab/ de nas khyed rang rnams sna bug g.yon bkag g.yas nas rlung lan gsum bus pa'i dang pos khrag mkhris kyi rgyu gsal ba la der 'dzin zhugs pa/ rlung gi rgyu stong pa la der 'dzin zhugs pa/ bad kan dang 'dus pa'i rgyu zung 'jug la der 'dzin zhugs pa rnams phyir bus/

gnyis pas khrag mkhris rlung bad kan 'dus pa rnams bus/ gsum pas 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum ka 'dres pa'i rnam rtog rnams bus pa'i mos pas rlung ro lan gsum phyir bsal ba'i mthar nang du 'ong mi gzhug par thub tshad cig phyir 'jog par zhu/ zhes brjod la rlung 'bud cing phyir 'jog tu gzhug de nas sna bug g.yas bkag g.yon nas rdzas dud rngub pa dang lhan cig tu mchil ma mid pa dang bcas rlung nang du thub tshad bzung bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad ye dharmā'i sngags kyi yig 'bru gser 'od ltar 'bar ba dang*/ rten 'brel gyi dud pas khengs pas nyon mongs nad gdon rnam rtog thams cad zhi ba'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob dpon gyis spos phor du rdzas dud sbyar brten snying bzla zhing slob ma re re nas bdug slob mas rlung du rngub 'dzin bya/ de brtan pa'i phyir khyed rang rnams me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor me tog bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i nyon mongs nad gdon rnam rtog thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor theb gsum du zan ril mtheb rdog las che tsam dkyil kyong mor dkar rgyan btab pa re dang*/ changs bu re bcug chus sbyang*/ las kyi rdo rjes slob ma rnams la g.yas skor gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis skyabs sbyin mthar mchog sbyin se gol dang bcas/ oṃ sarba bighān sogs dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces dang*/ sbyong chas phyir dor/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ nyungs kar gyis brab/

rdo rje dril bu gsor dkrol bcas a mṛ ta sogs brjod/ de nas phyogs skyong gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ lag g.yas khu tshur la mdzub mo bkug pa'i phyag rgya bskor te/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣā ya dzaḥs mgron dgug thal mo khong stong mthar se gol bcas gong gi sngags kyi sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ rdo rje thugs kar bzung zhing dril bu chig rdung gis/ 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol la gtor ma phyir bskyal/ 'o des rten 'brel zab mo'i byin rlabs gsan pa yin pas nyin re bzhin rten 'brel snying po ci nus bzla ba sogs dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la bsrung bsdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod dbul ba/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsams la stong pa dang rten 'byung zab mo'i don la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa bya ba las rjes chog gzhan mi dgos so// gnyis pa rgyun gyi nyams len ni/ de ltar byin rlabs zab mo legs par thob nas/ nyin zhag phrugs re'i tho rangs kyi dus su grub na gong du bshad pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba'i skabs ltar skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i mjug gi gsol 'debs bar nyams su blangs la/ mdun gyi lha mi dmigs par bsams te rten 'brel zab mo'i don la mnyam par bzhag cing bsngo smon bya/

mchod pa ni dngos su bsham pa dang*/ byin rlabs mi dgos/ yid kyis sprul te phul lo// de tsam ma grub na mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i zhal nas rten 'brel zab mo'i sngags tshig tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis bka' stsal pa rjes su bzlas pas rang gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la gzungs ji ltar rigs pa bzla'o// 'di'i bsnyen pa byed par 'dod na sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar mchod pa bsham/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i skabs ji lta bar thun gsum mam bzhir nyams su blangs la gzungs 'bum phrag gcig bzla' bar bya'o// de lta bu'i rgyun dang dus kyi nyams len la brtson pas/ gnas skabs su nad dang gnod pa thams cad srung zhing zhi ba dang*/ legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel thams cad 'bad med 'byung ba dang*/ lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzla ba sogs kyi nus pa mtha' dag tshad med par 'phel bas las rab 'byams gang brtsam pa thogs pa med par 'grub pas mtshon phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ mthar thug rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i don khong du chud pas 'phags pa'i lam gyi ye shes rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ba yin no// gsum pa las sgrub pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ 'di nyid kyi cho ga zhib mo las ji ltar 'byung ba dang*/ gzungs dang man ngag gzhan las 'byung ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i sgom bzlas dang*/ las kyi rim pa dngos so// dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i dad pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis yid la byas te/ ye dharmā sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi tshigs su bcad pa 'dis sems can rnams kyis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lugs dang mthun pa dang*/ lugs dang mi mthun pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa dang ldog pa dag gsungs te/

ji ltar las dang nyon mongs pa yod na ni sems can thams cad 'khor ba la 'jug par 'gyur la/ las dang nyon mongs pa med na ni 'khor ba las ldog go zhes bya ba'i bden pa'i tshig 'dis bdag gis cho ga zhib mo 'di 'grub par gyur cig ces rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i don rjes su dran pas bden pa'i tshig gis sems bskyed pa lan gsum du bya'o// de nas thal mo sbyar la/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rang sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gzungs kyi mthu bskyed pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi spyi bor

lha bsgom pa ni rgya 'grel du rang gi lag mthil la ma lus par bkod par gsungs shing*/ mchan rnying las lag pa'i mthil lam spyi gtsug ces 'byung*/ seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma'i snying por rab tu rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum ngur smrig gi mdog can gsol ba/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od zer me'i phung po lta bu'i klong na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ ces gsal la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas mnyam par bzhag pa ni lha'i sku rjes su dran pa'o// de nas gzungs bzla ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la dmigs pa dang*/ gzungs kyi tshig don rjes su dran pas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ye dharmā nas shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/ zhes ji tsam nus pa bzlas te las kyi cho ga so so la 'jug mthar lha'i sku mi dmigs par bsams la dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ rten cing 'brel 'byung sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas spyod lam dge ba'i bya ba la brtson par bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig byas na ji skad gsungs pa'i las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par 'gyur te/ cho ga'i gzungs las/ bzlas brjod 'bum ni byas gyur na// dgos pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so// gnyis pa la bcu/ dang po nad gso ba'i las kyi cho ga ni/ rims la sogs pa nad gang yang rung bas btab pa la/ gzungs mang du bzlas pa'i mthar langs te/ lag g.yas rdo rje'i khu tshur dang bcas pas nad pa'i lus la bskor zhing byabs/ gzungs kyi mthar rims la sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā/ dang*/ nad gzhan la sarba ro ge bh+yaḥ.a pa nā ya swā hā/

zhes mang du brjod cing thal mo sprugs te dor ba'i tshul byas pas nad thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blangs pa ltar 'dus nas nad bdag so so la thim par bsams pas zhi bar 'gyur ro// yang na bu mo gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa dkar po sum bsgril la mdud pa gsum byas la gzungs sngags nyi shu rtsa brgyad bzlas pas btab nas gang gi mgul du btags na srung ba dang zhi bar 'gyur ro// snying ga dang rtsib logs na ba la chu grang mo la bzlas te btang bas sel bar 'gyur ro// gzhan yang nad gang thebs pa la tshabs dang bstun te bzlas brjod byas la chu bskol lam/ nad so so la phan pa'i sman la btab ste btang na 'phral du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// g.yen pa dang 'brum bu sogs lhan skyes dang glo bur gyi rma'i rigs la/ grog ma'i tshang gi sa la sngags btab pas byugs na phan par 'gyur ro// gzhang 'brum dang*/ mtshan ma'i nad la skyes pa'i khaṇ+ḍa'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i ril bu zhes mchan rnying par gangs tig tu bshad pas/ de'i phye ma la sngags nyi shu bzlas te byugs pas bde bar 'gyur ro// 'khru na/ 'khru ba gcod pa'i sman nam/ byang chub sems dpa'i ril bu'am/ 'bras chan la sogs pa 'phrod pa'i kha zas la lan bdun nam nyi shu sogs bzlas te btang na phan par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa lo tog la nye bar phan pa'i cho ga la/ chu klung chen po'i bye ma dang*/ ri chen po'i rtse mo'i sa dang*/ dur khrod kyi thal chen rnams la brgya rtsa brgyad sngags nas gtor na lo tog dang*/ bza' shing gi rwa ba la 'tshe ba'i sems can gyi kha 'ching bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das la phul ba'i me tog rnying pa ste/ maṇ+ḍal sogs kyi me tog rnying pa la sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ gtsang zhing bla gab med pa'i phyogs su maṇ+ḍal chen po'i dbus su rdza'i bum pa chus bkang ba bzhag de'i steng du kham phor du me bzhag la me tog bsregs pa'i dud pa rgyun mi chad par 'thul bar byas na char ha cang ches pa gcod par 'gyur ro// shing se ba'am/

skyer pa'i lcug ma la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te ser pa 'ong ba'i phyogs su klad la bskor zhing byabs pas ser ba 'phral du bzlog par 'gyur ro// yang na thal chen dang yungs kar la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i thum po se ba'am/ skyer pa'i lcug pa'i mgul du gdags te ser ba 'grim pa'i srang du btsugs na mtshams bcad par 'gyur te/ 'di la nang gses su lo tog la phan gdags pa dang*/ char gcod pa dang*/ sprin zlog pa'i cho ga zhes gsungs so// gsum pa gdon gyis zin pa la phan gdags pa bum pa'i cho ga ni/ stegs bu 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ bum pa gtsang ma lnga'am/ ma 'byor na gcig legs par bkrus te gu gul gyis bdug nang du chu gtsang ma dang yungs kar/ ga pur/ tsan+dan dkar po/ gla rtsi/ gzhan yang shu dag sogs dri dang ldan zhing gdon 'phrog pa'i sman gyi rigs rnams legs par sbyar bas sum gnyis dgang ste kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa bzhag sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas chu nus ldan du byin gyis brlab pa'am/ spro na gzungs sgrub spyi ltar bya/ de nas dkon mchog gi rten me long du 'char ba la sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu slar yang bum par blugs te/ nad pa khrus stegs kyi dbus su bzhag pa'am/ stan dkar po'i steng du gos dkar po dang bcas khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas 'khod du gzhug la bkru ba tsam mam/ bkru byabs srung gsum spyi ltar byas la bum chu khong du btang*/ lus la gtor zhing bden tshig dang shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher byas pas gdon thams cad zhi ba dang srung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// bzhi pa byis pa la phan gdags pa'i cho ga ni/ byis pa'i gdon spyi la/ gi'u wang la mngon par bsngags te/ de'i khu bas gro ga'am/ shog bu gtsang ma la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dhā ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi dh+wan+sa ya dzā ṭi lam+bo dha ra utsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/

zhes bris la gzungs sngags kyis rab tu gnas pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i yungs kar gyi thum po bcas gtsang sbra dang ldan pas mgul du gdags na gdon thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bye brag tu mkha' 'gro ste bya'i gdon gyis zin pa la yungs kar dang*/ gu gul nag po la rten snying dang*/ gong gi sngags 'di nyid lan bdun bzlas pa'i thum po mgul du gdags pa dang*/ dud pas bdugs na zhi zhing srung bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa rigs brgyud spel ba'i cho ga la/ bud med mo gsham la bu 'byung bar 'dod na/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs byin rlabs can la sku khrus gsol ba'i chu slar yang bum par blugs la sngags bzlas pas byin gyis brlab pa'am/ gzungs sgrub tshul bzhin du bya/ de nas ra ba bzhi gang yang rung ba'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig gi nyin bud med de nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra legs par byas la/ bum pa'i chu blud pas rigs brgyud 'phel bar 'gyur ro// sbrum ma bde bar btsa' bar 'dod na/ chu gtsang ma la bzlas brjod bgyis pa khong du btang zhing*/ mar la bsngags te skye gnas la byugs pas bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur ro// drug pa lam du zhugs pa la nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i cho ga ni/ skud pa dkar po'am gos kyi grwar mdud pa bdun bya/ mdud pa re la sngags tshar re btab pa bcings te phyin na 'jigs pa thams cad srung zhing*/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ro// bdun pa yid gzhungs pa'i cho ga ni/ shu dag tshon gang ba dang*/ zhun mar srang sum brgya drug cu la sngags bzlas pa lhan cig tu bsres nas bum par blugs/ lo gcig tu nyi ma re re bzhin shu dag gi dum bu dang*/ mar srang re la bzlas brjod byas te bsten pa'am/ yang na ba ser skya'i mar dang 'o ma la bzlas te lhan cig tu sbyar ba sna ma'i shing gis dkrugs te zos pas blo gros dang ldan cing yid gzhungs pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ro// brgyad pa mdza' bar 'gyur ba'i cho ga ni/

me tog dmar po'am/ rtswa dang shing gi dum bu'am/ rgun 'bru la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'am/ ba'i lci ba 'di la dpe rnams su 'jim pa dang*/ 'ji ba sogs sna tshogs snang yang mchan rnying du 'di ltar gda'/ sa la ma lhungs pa lag g.yas pa'i changs par bcug sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te gang gi lag tu byin pa de dang snying nye ba'i mdza' bshes mchog tu 'gyur ro// dgu pa mi nad dang phyugs nad srung ba'i cho ga ni/ yungs kar la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i thum po sgo gong du gdags na gnas der mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad zhi zhing srung bar 'gyur ro// rta la sogs pa'i phyugs kyi rigs 'chi bar nye ba'i nad kyis thebs pa na/ chu dang yungs kar la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas lus la gtor na sos par 'gyur ro// yungs kar la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i thum po mgul du gdags na nad dang gnod pa thams cad srung zhing zhi bar 'gyur ro// bcu pa rgyun du bzlas brjod bya ba'i cho ga ni/ tho rangs snga bar langs te/ kha shar du phyogs pa'am phyogs par mos la gong du bshad pa ltar sgom bzlas chag med du bgyis pa'i phan yon ni/ 'di'i cho ga'i gzungs las/ rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na ni// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur// gnod pas cis kyang tshugs mi 'gyur// dam chos yongs su gzung bar 'gyur// zhes so// de rnams kyang ston pa sangs rgyas dang des gsungs pa'i gzungs sngags la yid ches pa'i dad pa brtan pos bsgrub na nges par 'grub pa yin te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gi /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab// cho ga de dag thams cad ni// gang la dad pas yid ches na// 'grub par the tshom med par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa gzungs dang man ngag gzhan las ji ltar 'byung ba ni/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i snying po'i gzungs las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/

mi gnas pa'i sa phyogs su mchod rten ni skyu ru ra'i 'bru tsam/ srog shing ni khab tsam/ gdugs ni ba ku la'i me tog tsam zhig byas la/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba chos kyi dbyings kyi tshigs su bcad pa nang du bcug na/ des tshangs pa'i bsod nams bskyed par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos shing 'chi ba'i dus byas nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro// de nas shi 'phos te 'chi ba'i dus byas nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes rgya cher bsngags pa'i mchod rten gyi las bya bar 'dod na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mchod rten dngos sam/ cho ga ltar 'du byas pa'i sāts+tsha'i nang du rten snying gi gzungs gzhug cing rab tu gnas par bya ste/ de'i tshul ni gzhan du gsal ba ltar ro// de bzhin du 'di'i sgo nas gzungs chu bsgrub pa dang*/ rten la sku khrus gsol ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i tshul rnams ni bka' gdams lha bzhi'i thub pa'i las tshogs su gsal bas der rtogs par bya zhing*/ gzhan yang phan byed kyi gdams pa phran tshegs la/ 'bru 'phel bar 'dod na/ 'bru sna tshogs dri bzang gi chus sbags pa la mngon par bsngags te rdul phra rab re re bzhin 'bru'i phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phel ba'i rang bzhin can du bsams la sa bon dang lhan cig tu 'debs par bya'o// phyugs 'phel bar 'dod na/ gro ga'am shog bu la gzungs bris te gi'u wang gis byug rab tu gnas pa dang bcas skar ma rgyal gyi nyin phyugs ma dge mtshan can gyi gdong pa la gdags par bya'o// rin po che 'phel bar 'dod na/ bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma can gyi bum par rin po che ji ltar rnyed pa bcug lag pa g.yas pas kha bkab ste bzlas brjod mang du byas la gter chen po'i bum par bsam/ dar ram ras ser pos kha bcad la bang mdzod kyi dbus su sba bar bya'o// zas 'phel bar 'dod na/

kha zas bzang rgu sna tshogs la sngar bzhin bzlas brjod byas la/ rdza'i ga 'ur bcug ste thab kyi dbus su sba bar bya'o// mig gi nad zhi bar 'dod na/ tho rangs blangs pa'i chu bsil gtsang ma'am/ zas ma zos gong gi mchil ma la lan bdun bsngags te g.yas g.yon go ldog pa'i srin lag gis byugs pas phan par 'gyur ro// rna ba'i nad zhi bar 'dod na/ zhun mar dang la phug gi sa bon la bsngags nas blugs par bya'o// gdong pa dang so srin gyi nad la/ a dang ye dharmā brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas bong nga nag po sran ma tsam la btab ste bdug pa'am/ so bar du bzung bas phan par 'gyur ro// gre ba 'gags na a ru ra'i khu ba'am/ dri chu bar pa la btab nas btang na 'phral du sel lo// yid mi bde ba la a ga ru nag po dang til mar bsres pa la bsngags nas du bas bdug pas phan no// rmi lam ngan pa zhi bar 'dod na/ rang gi spyi bor ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba me 'bar ba dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ sngags bzlas pas de las ye shes kyi me cher 'bar bas rmi lam ngan pa rgyu dang bcas pa sreg par bsams la gzungs drag tu bzla'o// rtsod pa dang phas rgol zhi bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba gsal btab la bzlas pas/ de las 'od zer dkar po bdud rtsi'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'phros/ pha rol la reg pas sdang bar sems pa thams cad zhi nas/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan par bsams la gzungs bzla/ snying rje drag tu bsgom mo// nad zhi bar 'dod na/ gang na ba'i gnas su zla ba la sngags phreng bkod/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas nad zhi bar bsams la bzla/ stong nyid zab mo'i don la blo bzhag par bya'o// tshe bsring bar 'dod na/ spyi gtsug tu gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram 'od 'bar ba'i lte bar zla ba la gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba gsal btab la bzlas pas 'jig rten dang*/

'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud thams cad 'dus te sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob/ rdo rje las rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pa byung ste lus kyi phyi nas rdo rje'i go khrab kyi tshul du g.yogs par bsams la bzlas pas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur ro// de rnams ni zhar las 'ongs pa ste man ngag sna tshogs pa las nye bar btus pa'o// rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs sngags chu gter las// legs 'ongs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa// phan bde'i char 'bebs bdud rtsi'i sprin chen 'dis// 'gro kun don gnyis ngal 'tsho rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang rten 'brel srung ba'i yi ge rnying pa mchan bu dang bcas cung zad mi 'dra ba le tshan gsum dang*/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi yi ge la gzhi byas/ gzungs gnyis kyi rnam bshad dang*/ mchan bu sogs rgya bod kyi yig cha man ngag dang bcas pa rnams kyis zur brgyan te/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun srid pa dang zhi ba'i dge legs kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la dus rtag tu longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
